title: timerfindall
summary: Find all timer objects by exact property value.

gpu_support.notes: `timerfindall` queries host-side timer handles and does not use acceleration providers.

description: `timerfindall` returns valid timer handles regardless of `ObjectVisibility`, optionally filtered by exact property values.
behaviors: `timerfindall` returns visible and invisible valid timers in the current runtime thread.
A single match returns a scalar timer handle. Zero or multiple matches return a 1-by-N cell row because RunMat does not yet have first-class MATLAB object arrays.
Deleted timers are removed from discovery.
gpu_behavior: `timerfindall` is host-side handle registry lookup and has no GPU behavior.
